item.title: Pushing the Boundaries of PQC for IoT
item.description: We’re dedicated to bringing robust, next-generation cryptography to even the most resource-constrained devices. One direction of ongoing work has focused heavily on implementing and optimizing the NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptographic algorithms, ML-KEM (formerly Kyber) and ML-DSA (formerly Dilithium), along with the SHA-3 hash function, specifically for the Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. All of our technical work and results are open source and available on our Github repository .

item.title: High Assurance Post-Quantum Cryptography for IoT
item.description: We extend the libcrux cryptographic library with support for resource constrained IoT devices. The libcrux-iot library contains high performance, high assurance implementations of post-quantum, as well as classical, cryptographic primitives.
